---
title: "PDF and CDF Explorer"
---

## PDF and CDF Explorer

Type a simple nonnegative function, choose an interval, and click **Draw PDF and CDF**.

The function will be numerically normalized so that the total area under the PDF is 1.

Examples you can try:

- `1`
- `x^2`
- `exp(-x)`
- `exp(-x^2 / 2)`
- `x >= 0 and x <= 1 ? 1 : 0`

```{=html}
<script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-2.35.2.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/mathjs/13.1.1/math.min.js"></script>

<div id="pdf-cdf-demo" style="max-width: 900px; margin-top: 1em;">

  <div style="margin-bottom: 12px;">
    <label for="pdf-input"><strong>PDF shape:</strong></label><br>
    <input
      id="pdf-input"
      type="text"
      value="exp(-x^2 / 2)"
      style="width: 100%; max-width: 650px; padding: 6px; font-size: 16px;"
    >
  </div>

  <div style="display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 12px;">
    <div>
      <label for="xmin-input"><strong>x min:</strong></label><br>
      <input id="xmin-input" type="number" value="-4" step="0.1" style="width: 100px; padding: 6px;">
    </div>

    <div>
      <label for="xmax-input"><strong>x max:</strong></label><br>
      <input id="xmax-input" type="number" value="4" step="0.1" style="width: 100px; padding: 6px;">
    </div>

    <div>
      <label for="n-input"><strong>Grid points:</strong></label><br>
      <input id="n-input" type="number" value="500" min="100" max="3000" step="100" style="width: 120px; padding: 6px;">
    </div>
  </div>

  <button onclick="drawPdfCdf()" style="padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 16px;">
    Draw PDF and CDF
  </button>

  <button onclick="loadPdfCdfExample('normal')" style="padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 16px; margin-left: 6px;">
    Normal shape
  </button>

  <button onclick="loadPdfCdfExample('exponential')" style="padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 16px; margin-left: 6px;">
    Exponential shape
  </button>

  <button onclick="loadPdfCdfExample('uniform')" style="padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 16px; margin-left: 6px;">
    Uniform shape
  </button>

  <p id="pdf-cdf-message" style="margin-top: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></p>

  <div id="pdf-plot" style="width: 100%; height: 420px; cursor: crosshair;"></div>
  <div id="cdf-plot" style="width: 100%; height: 420px; margin-top: 20px; cursor: crosshair;"></div>

</div>

<script>
let currentX = [];
let currentPdf = [];
let currentCdf = [];
let currentXMin = -4;
let currentXMax = 4;
let currentPdfMax = 1;

function loadPdfCdfExample(type) {
  if (type === "normal") {
    document.getElementById("pdf-input").value = "exp(-x^2 / 2)";
    document.getElementById("xmin-input").value = -4;
    document.getElementById("xmax-input").value = 4;
  }

  if (type === "exponential") {
    document.getElementById("pdf-input").value = "x >= 0 ? exp(-x) : 0";
    document.getElementById("xmin-input").value = 0;
    document.getElementById("xmax-input").value = 8;
  }

  if (type === "uniform") {
    document.getElementById("pdf-input").value = "x >= 0 and x <= 1 ? 1 : 0";
    document.getElementById("xmin-input").value = -0.5;
    document.getElementById("xmax-input").value = 1.5;
  }

  drawPdfCdf();
}

function trapezoidArea(x, y) {
  let area = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < x.length; i++) {
    const dx = x[i] - x[i - 1];
    area += 0.5 * dx * (y[i] + y[i - 1]);
  }
  return area;
}

function cumulativeTrapezoid(x, y) {
  let cdf = [0];

  for (let i = 1; i < x.length; i++) {
    const dx = x[i] - x[i - 1];
    const addedArea = 0.5 * dx * (y[i] + y[i - 1]);
    cdf.push(cdf[i - 1] + addedArea);
  }

  return cdf;
}

function nearestIndex(xArray, xValue) {
  let bestIndex = 0;
  let bestDistance = Math.abs(xArray[0] - xValue);

  for (let i = 1; i < xArray.length; i++) {
    const distance = Math.abs(xArray[i] - xValue);
    if (distance < bestDistance) {
      bestDistance = distance;
      bestIndex = i;
    }
  }

  return bestIndex;
}

function makePdfShadeTrace(index) {
  const shadeX = currentX.slice(0, index + 1);
  const shadeY = currentPdf.slice(0, index + 1);

  return {
    x: shadeX,
    y: shadeY,
    type: "scatter",
    mode: "lines",
    fill: "tozeroy",
    name: "Area = CDF",
    line: {
      width: 0
    },
    fillcolor: "rgba(76, 120, 168, 0.25)",
    hoverinfo: "skip",
    showlegend: false
  };
}

function getMouseXValue(event, plotId) {
  const plot = document.getElementById(plotId);
  const rect = plot.getBoundingClientRect();
  const xaxis = plot._fullLayout.xaxis;

  const mouseX = event.clientX - rect.left;

  const xPixelInsideAxis = mouseX - xaxis._offset;
  const xValue = xaxis.p2c(xPixelInsideAxis);

  if (!Number.isFinite(xValue)) {
    return null;
  }

  if (xValue < currentXMin || xValue > currentXMax) {
    return null;
  }

  return xValue;
}

function updateHoverDisplay(xValue) {
  const index = nearestIndex(currentX, xValue);
  const xHover = currentX[index];
  const pdfHover = currentPdf[index];
  const cdfHover = currentCdf[index];

  const midX = (currentXMin + currentXMax) / 2;
  const boxAnchor = xHover < midX ? "left" : "right";
  const boxShift = xHover < midX ? 12 : -12;

  const pdfShape = {
    type: "line",
    x0: xHover,
    x1: xHover,
    y0: 0,
    y1: currentPdfMax * 1.08,
    line: {
      color: "gray",
      width: 1.5,
      dash: "dot"
    }
  };

  const cdfShape = {
    type: "line",
    x0: xHover,
    x1: xHover,
    y0: 0,
    y1: 1.05,
    line: {
      color: "gray",
      width: 1.5,
      dash: "dot"
    }
  };

  const pdfBox = {
    x: xHover,
    y: 0.75,
    xref: "x",
    yref: "paper",
    text:
      "x: " + xHover.toFixed(4) + "<br>" +
      "pdf: " + pdfHover.toFixed(4) + "<br>" +
      "cdf: " + cdfHover.toFixed(4),
    showarrow: false,
    xanchor: boxAnchor,
    yanchor: "middle",
    xshift: boxShift,
    align: "left",
    bgcolor: "rgba(255, 127, 14, 0.90)",
    bordercolor: "rgba(80, 80, 80, 1)",
    borderwidth: 1,
    font: {
      size: 14,
      color: "black"
    }
  };

  const cdfBox = {
    x: xHover,
    y: 0.75,
    xref: "x",
    yref: "paper",
    text:
      "x: " + xHover.toFixed(4) + "<br>" +
      "pdf: " + pdfHover.toFixed(4) + "<br>" +
      "cdf: " + cdfHover.toFixed(4),
    showarrow: false,
    xanchor: boxAnchor,
    yanchor: "middle",
    xshift: boxShift,
    align: "left",
    bgcolor: "rgba(31, 119, 180, 0.90)",
    bordercolor: "rgba(80, 80, 80, 1)",
    borderwidth: 1,
    font: {
      size: 14,
      color: "white"
    }
  };

  const shadeTrace = makePdfShadeTrace(index);

  Plotly.restyle("pdf-plot", {
    x: [shadeTrace.x],
    y: [shadeTrace.y]
  }, [0]);

  Plotly.relayout("pdf-plot", {
    shapes: [pdfShape],
    annotations: [pdfBox]
  });

  Plotly.relayout("cdf-plot", {
    shapes: [cdfShape],
    annotations: [cdfBox]
  });
}

function drawPdfCdf() {
  const message = document.getElementById("pdf-cdf-message");
  message.innerText = "";

  const expr = document.getElementById("pdf-input").value;
  const xmin = Number(document.getElementById("xmin-input").value);
  const xmax = Number(document.getElementById("xmax-input").value);
  const n = Number(document.getElementById("n-input").value);

  if (!Number.isFinite(xmin) || !Number.isFinite(xmax) || xmin >= xmax) {
    message.innerText = "Please enter a valid interval with x min < x max.";
    return;
  }

  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 50) {
    message.innerText = "Please enter a reasonable number of grid points.";
    return;
  }

  let compiled;
  try {
    compiled = math.compile(expr);
  } catch (error) {
    message.innerText = "The function expression could not be parsed.";
    return;
  }

  const x = [];
  const rawY = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const xi = xmin + (xmax - xmin) * i / (n - 1);
    let yi;

    try {
      yi = compiled.evaluate({ x: xi });
    } catch (error) {
      message.innerText = "The function could not be evaluated. Check your syntax.";
      return;
    }

    yi = Number(yi);

    if (!Number.isFinite(yi)) {
      message.innerText = "The function produced a non-finite value. Try another interval.";
      return;
    }

    if (yi < 0) {
      message.innerText = "A PDF must be nonnegative. Your function is negative somewhere on this interval.";
      return;
    }

    x.push(xi);
    rawY.push(yi);
  }

  const area = trapezoidArea(x, rawY);

  if (!Number.isFinite(area) || area <= 0) {
    message.innerText = "The total area is zero or invalid. Please enter a positive function.";
    return;
  }

  const pdf = rawY.map(v => v / area);
  const cdf = cumulativeTrapezoid(x, pdf);
  const finalCdf = cdf[cdf.length - 1];
  const cdfNormalized = cdf.map(v => v / finalCdf);

  currentX = x;
  currentPdf = pdf;
  currentCdf = cdfNormalized;
  currentXMin = xmin;
  currentXMax = xmax;
  currentPdfMax = Math.max(...pdf, 1e-8);

  message.innerText =
    "Numerical normalizing constant before scaling: " + area.toFixed(5);

  const startIndex = Math.floor(x.length / 2);

  const pdfShadeTrace = makePdfShadeTrace(startIndex);

  const pdfTrace = {
    x: x,
    y: pdf,
    type: "scatter",
    mode: "lines",
    name: "PDF",
    line: {
      width: 3
    },
    customdata: cdfNormalized,
    hovertemplate:
      "x: %{x:.4f}<br>" +
      "pdf: %{y:.4f}<br>" +
      "cdf: %{customdata:.4f}<extra></extra>"
  };

  const cdfTrace = {
    x: x,
    y: cdfNormalized,
    type: "scatter",
    mode: "lines",
    name: "CDF",
    line: {
      width: 3
    },
    customdata: pdf,
    hovertemplate:
      "x: %{x:.4f}<br>" +
      "pdf: %{customdata:.4f}<br>" +
      "cdf: %{y:.4f}<extra></extra>"
  };

  const pdfLayout = {
    title: "PDF: density curve",
    showlegend: false,
    hovermode: false,
    xaxis: {
      title: "x",
      range: [xmin, xmax],
      showspikes: true,
      spikemode: "across",
      spikesnap: "cursor",
      spikedash: "dot",
      spikethickness: 1
    },
    yaxis: {
      title: "pdf(x)",
      rangemode: "tozero",
      range: [0, currentPdfMax * 1.15]
    },
    margin: {
      l: 60,
      r: 30,
      t: 60,
      b: 60
    },
    shapes: [
      {
        type: "line",
        x0: x[startIndex],
        x1: x[startIndex],
        y0: 0,
        y1: currentPdfMax * 1.08,
        line: {
          color: "gray",
          width: 1.5,
          dash: "dot"
        }
      }
    ]
  };

  const cdfLayout = {
    title: "CDF: accumulated area under the PDF",
    showlegend: false,
    hovermode: false,
    xaxis: {
      title: "x",
      range: [xmin, xmax],
      showspikes: true,
      spikemode: "across",
      spikesnap: "cursor",
      spikedash: "dot",
      spikethickness: 1
    },
    yaxis: {
      title: "cdf(x)",
      range: [0, 1.05]
    },
    margin: {
      l: 60,
      r: 30,
      t: 60,
      b: 60
    },
    shapes: [
      {
        type: "line",
        x0: x[startIndex],
        x1: x[startIndex],
        y0: 0,
        y1: 1.05,
        line: {
          color: "gray",
          width: 1.5,
          dash: "dot"
        }
      }
    ]
  };

  const config = {
    responsive: true,
    displayModeBar: true
  };

  Plotly.newPlot("pdf-plot", [pdfShadeTrace, pdfTrace], pdfLayout, config);
  Plotly.newPlot("cdf-plot", [cdfTrace], cdfLayout, config);

  updateHoverDisplay(x[startIndex]);

  const pdfPlot = document.getElementById("pdf-plot");
  const cdfPlot = document.getElementById("cdf-plot");

  pdfPlot.addEventListener("mousemove", function(event) {
    const xValue = getMouseXValue(event, "pdf-plot");
    if (xValue !== null) {
      updateHoverDisplay(xValue);
    }
  });

  cdfPlot.addEventListener("mousemove", function(event) {
    const xValue = getMouseXValue(event, "cdf-plot");
    if (xValue !== null) {
      updateHoverDisplay(xValue);
    }
  });
}

drawPdfCdf();
</script>
```
